goal:
Model a rectangular upper bearing cap with two spaced semicircular bush recesses and fastening holes.
Build as 3D solid geometry (boxes/cylinders/fuse/cut/fillet/holes).
Use approximate dimensions if none given; keep proportions from the description.
Fuse into one coherent solid when it is a single part; keep parts separate and export body_id=ALL only for true assemblies.
Export a STEP when finished.
Requirements:
- The completed model shall contain a single rectangular upper bearing-cap body.
- The cap shall include two spaced semicircular recesses along one longitudinal side for seating the bushes.
- The cap shall include multiple circular through holes distributed across the body for fastening.

goal:
Model a rigid forked mounting bracket with parallel lower arms, rounded mounting lugs, circular through-holes, and a perpendicular central upright lug.
Build as 3D solid geometry (boxes/cylinders/fuse/cut/fillet/holes).
Use approximate dimensions if none given; keep proportions from the description.
Fuse into one coherent solid when it is a single part; keep parts separate and export body_id=ALL only for true assemblies.
Export a STEP when finished.
Requirements:
- The part shall form a single coherent mounting bracket with two parallel lower arms joined through a central rear structure.
- Each lower arm shall terminate in a rounded lug containing a circular through-hole, with the two holes aligned across the fork.
- A central upright lug shall rise perpendicular to the lower arms and include a rounded upper end with a circular through-hole.
- The lower arms shall be separated by an open central slot that provides a clevis-style U-shaped profile.
- The bracket shall use clean planar webs and consistent prismatic plate forms, with rounded contours concentrated at the mounting-hole ends.
